scripts.typecheck: tsc --build packages/core packages/react packages/plugin --noEmit && tsc -p test --noEmit && pnpm --filter dev generate:types && tsc -p dev --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:packages && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config blame.ignoreRevsFile .git-blame-ignore-revs
scripts.lint:packages: for p in core react plugin; do publint packages/$p --strict && attw --pack packages/$p --profile esm-only --format ascii --quiet || exit 1; done
